assets.prompt:
A single small bird from the Chinese myth of Jingwei: crow-sized, with a dark indigo-black body, a patterned head, a white beak and bright red feet. Side view facing right, wings spread in flight, the whole bird visible. The bird is isolated in the middle of the board with a wide empty margin of board on every side.

Style: children's picture-book art made entirely of cut pieces of hand-painted tissue paper. Inside each piece: bold acrylic brush streaks, sponge mottling and comb-scraped texture in a few rich colours. Crisp scissor-cut edges. Flat, layered collage with no 3D shading and no outlines. Everything sits on a plain, flat, evenly lit cream paper board that fills the whole image. No cast shadows, no frame, no text, no letters, no numbers.
